import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0125 (A B : Set α) : (A ⊆ B ∧ B ⊆ A) ↔ A = B := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0125 (A B : Set α) : (A ⊆ B ∧ B ⊆ A) ↔ A = B := by
  split
  · intro h; split; intro x; exact h.1 x; intro x; exact h.2 x
  · intro h; apply subset. intros x; exact h x
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0125 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0125 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0125

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0125
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0125
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
